identity: N6 capacity evidence only; no iterative solver or full-field candidate

diagnostic_scope.state_definition: probe-0 baseline + 32 actual sequential histories + final five original fields
diagnostic_scope.row_order_gate: separate binary64 multiply/add in original CSC free-column order must reproduce every stored native row residual bitpattern
diagnostic_scope.exact_arithmetic: Fraction.from_float / float.as_integer_ratio; arbitrary-size integer dyadic arithmetic, no unchecked Decimal precision
diagnostic_scope.support_quantization: every support DOF requested/actual update and ULP distance across all 32 steps; source arrays independently reread
diagnostic_scope.row_sensitivity: both adjacent +/-1 ULP at every original free support column; all trials retained in deterministic column/direction order
diagnostic_scope.trial_bound: exactly twice original row-support count, support hard cap 4096; disabled on any replay mismatch

worker.memory_basis: stream NPY into typed arrays; original CSC about 285 MB; Kff hashed columnwise without storing a second full matrix; four field vectors, RHS, domain mapping and JSON packet; expected peak below 1 GiB, enforced 2 GiB AS
worker.time_basis: one 23.65M-entry Python filter/hash pass, 38 retained residual-vector reductions (~13.08M entries), sequential decompression of original arrays, exact dyadic arithmetic only on one sparse row; no factorization or full sparse matvec

independent_reader.basis: one independent linear scan of original CSC indices and all 38 original field/residual reads; separate scalar/Fraction replay; shares typed input I/O only
